chunks: 26 – Hishām ibn Sālim, al-Jawālīqī. Thiqa, thiqa.

key_terms.الْجَوَالِيْقِيُّ: Al-Jawālīqī, a nisba (attributive name) indicating origin or association
key_terms.ثِقَةٌ: Thiqa, meaning reliable, trustworthy, and competent in transmitting hadith
key_terms.هِشَامُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ: Hishām ibn Sālim, a specific narrator

ai.seo_question: Who is Hisham ibn Salim al-Jawaliqiy and what is his reliability status in Shia hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This entry provides a biographical assessment of the narrator Hishām ibn Sālim, known as al-Jawālīqī. He is described as 'thiqa' (reliable/trustworthy), a designation repeated for emphasis, indicating his high status in the science of narrator criticism (ʿilm al-rijāl).
